description:
Checks whether a day-by-day itinerary works: locates each stop, computes travel time between consecutive stops by walking, transit or taxi, and flags overlaps, too-tight transfers, venues closed on that weekday or at that time (from published opening hours, with when they were last confirmed), public holidays, overloaded days, long walking, backtracking (with a better order), city-to-city moves with time ranges by rail, flight and road, and flight check-in buffers. Returns a status, issues by severity with evidence and a fix, and the computed timeline. Deterministic calculations, not opinions. Costs 2 credits (free on the paid plan).

Examples:
- "Check this Lisbon day: Jerónimos 9:00, Belém Tower 10:00, Castelo de São Jorge 11:00, LX Factory 12:30, Gulbenkian 14:00"
- "Is Paris Monday 3 May 2027 Louvre then Orsay then Sacré-Cœur realistic?"
- "Validate this 10-day Portugal and Spain itinerary for a client using a wheelchair"

city.description: City for this day; carries forward to later days.

name.description: Venue or activity as written, e.g. 'Jerónimos Monastery', 'Lunch at Taberna da Rua das Flores'.

lodging.description: Hotel name for the night (the day starts and ends there).

destination.description: Default city when days don't name one.

max_walk_minutes.description: Longest walk the client accepts per leg (default 25; 10 with limited mobility).

pace.description: Default 'moderate' (about 8 h of activities a day).

start_date.description: Date of day 1 when days carry no dates.

transport.description: Default 'mixed': walk up to max_walk_minutes, else transit.

name: validate_itinerary
title: Validate Itinerary
